item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:50 HKT 18/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone to the east of the Philippines will move in the general direction of the northern part of Luzon today. It will enter the northern part of the South China Sea afterwards and intensify gradually, edging closer to the vicinity of the coast of western Guangdong. However, there are still uncertainties in its intensity. Under the influence of the outer subsiding air of the tropical cyclone, the weather will be persistently very hot over Guangdong today and tomorrow. Thundery showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. The tropical cyclone is expected to bring heavy squally showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea during the weekend to early next week. Seas will be rough with swells. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be a few showers over the coast of southern China midweek next week.
